title: Kumbukumbu za Mkutano Mkuu wa Mwaka 2026

headings.text: Kumbukumbu za Mkutano Mkuu wa Mwaka 2026

key_sentences: Mkutano ulifanyika tarehe 17 Oktoba 2026 katika ukumbi wa chama, kuanzia saa nne asubuhi.
Mwenyekiti aliwakaribisha wanachama na kuwashukuru kwa kuhudhuria kwa wingi licha ya mvua za asubuhi.
Kumbukumbu za mkutano uliopita zilisomwa na kuthibitishwa bila marekebisho.
Mweka hazina, Bw. Daudi Lyimo, aliwasilisha taarifa ya fedha ya mwaka 2025/2026.
Alieleza kwamba mauzo ya kahawa yaliongezeka kwa asilimia kumi na mbili ikilinganishwa na mwaka uliopita.
Gharama za usafirishaji zilipanda kutokana na ubovu wa barabara ya kwenda kiwandani.
Wanachama waliuliza maswali kuhusu mishahara ya watumishi, na mweka hazina aliyajibu kwa kina.
Mkutano ulifungwa saa tisa alasiri kwa sala.

list_items.text: Bei ya kahawa kwa msimu ujao
(a) Mkutano ulipitisha taarifa ya fedha ya mwaka 2025/2026 kama ilivyowasilishwa.
(b) Malipo ya pili kwa wakulima yatakuwa shilingi 450 kwa kila kilo ya kahawa safi.
(i) Malipo yatafanyika kupitia benki ifikapo tarehe 30 Novemba 2026.
(ii) Wakulima wasio na akaunti za benki watalipwa kupitia simu ya mkononi.
(c) Wajumbe watatu wapya wa bodi walichaguliwa kwa kura za siri.
Wanachama walikumbushwa kuchuma kahawa iliyoiva pekee ili kulinda ubora.
Mafunzo ya kupogoa miche yatafanyika mwezi Januari 2027.

notes: Swahili minutes of a cooperative's annual general meeting. Letterhead (name and address line beside a plain brown oval) is furniture; footer 'Ukurasa N wa M' once per page. The attendance key/value table (no header) FLOATS at the right of the opening paragraph and the agenda; the finance table FLOATS at the right of the treasurer's paragraph (table beside text). Read order: heading, attendance table, opening paragraph, agenda; then 'Taarifa ya Fedha', finance table, paragraph. The finance table is partly ruled: no grid, a rule above each total and a heavier rule above 'Ziada', two full-width section rows (Mapato, Matumizi). Lists: the agenda is CSS-numbered (decimal drawn by CSS); the resolutions use TYPED '(a)' '(b)' '(c)' with nested TYPED roman '(i)' '(ii)'; 'Mengineyo' uses CSS circle bullets. Signature lines at the end are not sentences.
